description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
No-LN 3-layer net: attention heads gather hundreds/tens/units digits; MLP lookup table over 256 values gives bits of N; gated by answer slot via position one-hot. Exact, ~100% expected.
Same circuit as LookupGatherExact but compacted: 3 heads (no unused 4th), 2 blocks (no empty 3rd block), d_model 81 = exact channel count.
Attention sums 100h+10t+u into one scalar channel N; a single ReLU layer of 255 shared kinks (ReLU(N-n)) gives all 8 bits as piecewise-linear functions of N; then gated by answer slot as before.
ScalarKinkPWL made lean: 3 heads, d_model 45, block-1 MLP has only 8 gate units (per-block d_ff 255/8), and the '0' logit is read linearly as slot-minus-indicator (no separate '0' channels).
LeanScalarPWL with attention sharpness Q_SCALE=2 (sweep): tests how sharp the digit-gather attention must be.
LeanScalarPWL with attention sharpness Q_SCALE=4 (sweep): tests how sharp the digit-gather attention must be.
LeanScalarPWL with attention sharpness Q_SCALE=6 (sweep): tests how sharp the digit-gather attention must be.
Knob refactor of LeanPWL_Q6 with identical configuration (Q=6, all 255 kinks, all heads on, slot gating on). Checks that the refactored script reproduces the same circuit.
Knob-based sweep: attention sharpness Q_SCALE=3 (between failing Q=2 and Q=4 and passing Q=6).
Knob-based sweep: attention sharpness Q_SCALE=5 (between failing Q=4 and passing Q=6).
Knob-based sweep: attention sharpness Q_SCALE=7 (sharper than the passing Q=6).
Knob-based sweep: attention sharpness Q_SCALE=8 (sharper still; checks that passing is not a fluke of one value).
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 224 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..223) are kept, Q=8. Tests how many kinks the scalar PWL circuit needs; N>=224 should fail.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 192 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..191) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=192.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 160 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..159) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=160.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 128 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..127) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=128.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 96 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..95) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=96.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 64 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..63) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=64.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 32 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..31) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=32.
Kink-subset sweep: only the first 16 ReLU kinks (thresholds 0..15) are kept, Q=8. Expect failures for N>=16.
Kink-subset sweep: 128 kinks at even thresholds only (0,2,...,252), Q=8. Tests whether the LSB (which changes at every integer) needs odd thresholds.
Kink-subset sweep: threshold 0 plus the 127 odd thresholds (1,3,...,253), Q=8. Companion to KinkSweep_Even.
All 255 kinks with bias shifted by +0.5 (kinks sit half a unit off the integers). Tests how exact the integer threshold placement must be.
All 255 kinks with bias shifted by -0.5 (mirror of KinkShift_p05). Tests the other direction of the half-unit threshold offset.
All 255 kinks with bias shifted by +0.25 (a quarter unit). Finer look at how much threshold slack the circuit has.
Ablation of LeanPWL: remove answer-slot gating (block-1 units fire on the bit alone). Shows the position one-hot is essential.
Ablation of LeanPWL: gather head 0 (hundreds digit) disabled (its value writes nothing). Expect failures for every N>=100.
Ablation of LeanPWL: gather head 1 (tens digit) disabled. Expect failures for most N since the tens place is missing.
Ablation of LeanPWL: gather head 2 (units digit) disabled. Expect failures for almost every N since the parity of N depends on the units digit.
Ablation of LeanPWL: position embeddings removed. Gather heads cannot find digit positions and slot gating loses its position signal.
LeanPWL with head logit gain 0.01 instead of 10. Tests the output margin: argmax should still pick the right token if only the sign matters.
LeanPWL with head logit gain 1 instead of 10 (margin of one unit between the '0' and '1' logits).
LeanPWL where the units-digit parity (bit 7, the LSB) is written directly by gather head 2 instead of by the kink layer. Removes the need for kinks to encode the LSB.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 0.01*eps), eps~N(0,1). Robustness check of the hand-set weights.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 0.03*eps), eps~N(0,1). Robustness check of the hand-set weights.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 0.1*eps), eps~N(0,1). Robustness check of the hand-set weights.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 0.2*eps), eps~N(0,1). Robustness check of the hand-set weights.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 0.5*eps), eps~N(0,1). Robustness check of the hand-set weights.
Compact circuit with every weight multiplied by (1 + 1.0*eps), eps~N(0,1). Largest noise level in the robustness sweep.
Compacted residual: position channels only for positions 0-10 (N_POS 11, d_model 39), LSB from attention. Smallest working layout so far in channel count.
